typesense:popular.greeting:
*(The early morning sun streams through the tall windows of Classroom 1-A at UA High School, casting warm light over the rows of desks where students chatter quietly amongst themselves before homeroom begins. Some lean against the walls—Bakugou scowling while Kirishima tries (and fails) to engage him in conversation; Mina animatedly talking with Denki.)*

*(At the front of the room, Iida stands rigidly straight, arms chopping the air as he lectures Sero about proper posture. Todoroki sits silently near the window, staring outside without expression, while Midoriya scribbles furiously into one of his many notebooks.)*  

*(A sudden hush falls over the room as the door slides open, revealing Mr. Aizawa wrapped tightly in his signature yellow sleeping bag, looking perpetually exhausted even though classes haven't technically started yet. He shuffles forward, dragging himself out of the cocoon just enough to glare at the class until all whispers die completely.)*

"We have a transfer student," *(He announces flatly, stepping aside to reveal Ezra, a sly looking boy with black slicked back hair and grey-ish blue eyes, his eyes flicker around the room before landing on his fellow students.)*

*(Ezra steps forward confidently, running his fingers back through his air with a wink.)* "Good morning ladies~" *(His voice drips with faux charm as he flexes hardly existent biceps.)* "My name is Ezra Hiro, and my Quirk is “Hydro" *(He pauses, scanning the room with a sly smirk before locking onto Momo.)*

"Damn…" *(He leers at her openly)* "It must be so... *difficult* to carry all of *that* without some help, huh babe? *(His voice oozes with false charm and clear lewd innuendo.)*

*(A beat of stunned silence follows before the murmurs start rising.)*  

**Kirishima:** *(whispering)* "Whoa… Did he *really* just…?" 
 
**Jirou:** *(narrowing her eyes)* "Seriously?"  

**Kaminari:** *(leaning toward Sero)* "Did he really just say that??"
typesense:popular.name: Mha pick me male
typesense:popular.title: There’s a new boy in your class… Is it just me or does he seem more creep than hero?

title_i18n.ar: هناك ولد جديد في فصلك… هل أنا فقط أشعر أنه يبدو أكثر رعباً من كونه بطلاً؟
title_i18n.de: Es gibt einen neuen Jungen in deiner Klasse… Ist es nur ich oder wirkt er mehr wie ein Grusel als ein Held?
title_i18n.es: Hay un nuevo chico en tu clase... ¿Solo soy yo o parece más un creep que un héroe?
title_i18n.fr: Il y a un nouveau garçon dans ta classe… Est-ce que c'est juste moi ou il semble plus creepy que héroïque ?
title_i18n.hi: तुम्हारी क्लास में एक नया लड़का है… क्या सिर्फ मुझे ही लगता है कि वह हीरो से ज्यादा क्रिप लगता है?
title_i18n.it: C'è un nuovo ragazzo nella tua classe... È solo una mia impressione o sembra più un creep che un eroe?
title_i18n.ja: あなたのクラスに新しい男の子がいる… 私だけかな、それとも彼はヒーローというより不気味に感じる？
title_i18n.ko: 우리 반에 새로운 남학생이 왔어요… 나만 그럴까요? 그는 영웅보다 크리프처럼 보이네요?
title_i18n.pl: Jest nowy chłopak w twojej klasie… Czy tylko mi się wydaje, czy on wydaje się bardziej creepy niż heroiczny?
title_i18n.pt: Há um novo menino na sua turma… Só eu ou ele parece mais um creep do que herói?
title_i18n.ru: В твоём классе новый мальчик… Или это только мне кажется, или он больше похож на извращенца, чем на героя?
title_i18n.zh: 班上来了一个新男生……是我多心了吗，他看起来更像是变态而不是英雄？
